newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Sporitelna sees four bond issues in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Czech Sporitelna sees four bond issues in 1997.

text.p: Czech savings bank Ceska Sporitelna a.s. on Wednesday said it expected to issue three separate tranches of bonds on the domestic market this year, totalling some 15 billion crowns.
It added in a statement that it also expected to raise the equivalent of five billion crowns through a fourth, foreign bond issue in 1997.
The statement added the domestic issues should all have maturities between five and 10 years.
It gave no further details on any of the bond issues.
Sporitelna is the country's largest savings bank with an estimated 70-80 percent of all consumer deposits.
